speaker: Nina
text: Hello? Is anyone here?

speaker: Mysterious Person
text: Leave this place. This is my domain.

speaker: Nina
text: oooookay...Well goodbye then.

speaker: Mysterious Person
text: No!…Wait.

speaker: Nina
text: Yes…?

speaker: Mysterious Person
text: Uhm...Why art thou here?

speaker: Nina
text: English? Please?

speaker: Mysterious Person
text: (Sigh) Who are you? Why are you here?

speaker: Nina
text: Oh, I’m Nina. I just wanted to know what this mystical cave was all about. Who are you?

speaker: Taz
text: Hm. Tazanguis Draconis. But My friends call me Taz. At least they would if I had any. *sniffle*

speaker: Nina
text: Everyone's so emotional on this island.

speaker: Nina
text: What should I ask?

choices.text: Why do you hang out in a cave?

speaker: Taz
text: WHAT!? NO!

speaker: Nina
text: Well you kinda look like a dragon.

speaker: Taz
text: Are you making fun of me?

speaker: Nina
text: Oh, heavens no.

speaker: Taz
text: Good. If you made fun of me for being a dragon I would be so enraged.

speaker: Taz
text: Because I'm half Dragon!

speaker: Taz
text: That's why I live in a cave.

speaker: Taz
text: My father was a dragon...And a deadbeat.

speaker: Nina
text: So then why aren't you a dragon?

speaker: Taz
text: Because my mother was a normal lizard. Not a dragon.

speaker: Nina
text: What! So why do you look kind of human?

speaker: Taz
text: Because I'm only half dragon

choices.text: How was your dad a deadbeat?

text.speaker: Nina
text.text: Sooooo...did you say earlier that your dad was a deadbeat?

text.speaker: Taz
text.text: Yeah he was the worst man I've ever met. Except he wasn't a man. He was a dragon.

text.speaker: Taz
text.text: Every time I think of him it makes my skin and scales crawl!

text.speaker: Taz
text.text: I have both because I'm half dragon.

text.speaker: Nina
text.text: Look I feel like this conversation is getting maybe a little repetitive.

text.speaker: Taz
text.text: Huh, mundane repetition. That must be the human in me.

text.speaker: Nina
text.text: I'm confused. If you're half dragon and half lizard, where does the human part come from?

text.speaker: Taz
text.text: Well all dragons are lizards but not all lizards are dragons.

text.speaker: Nina
text.text: Ok yeah, that much I understand. How is that relevant?

text.speaker: Taz
text.text: Because my father was a dragon

text.speaker: Taz
text.text: All this talk of my dark past has made me tired and thirsty.

text.speaker: Taz
text.text: Would you be a lamb and whip me up a coffee?

text.speaker: Taz
text.text: MMMM YUMMY! I mean ugh that was fine or whatever. Shouldn't you go to the blood temple to watch Jimmy F train or something?
